judiciary_art4section5tracker.a_severity: a severity-scaled panel of the {name}, {name2} writing.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.due_within: due within {timeframe_days} days of the finding · {remedy} · Art. IV §5 — opinions remain commentary on the law as edited
judiciary_art4section5tracker.enforcemen: Enforcement aligns to the final state of the law: amended, upheld by override, or edited by the court. Executive actions
judiciary_art4section5tracker.executives: Executives enforce the outcome — whichever path resolves
judiciary_art4section5tracker.filed_by_a: Filed: {filed_at} by {filed_by_label} — any inhabitant may file; no standing gatekeeper beyond jurisdictional association.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.if_the_win: If the window closes with neither amendment nor override, the judiciary applies its remedy directly to the law’s text. Version history is preserved.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.is_edited_: {name} is edited to the text above; a new law version is published with the prior version retained in history. Version {version_no} (prior: {prior_version_no}) →
judiciary_art4section5tracker.no_constit: No constitutional challenge is open in your jurisdictions
judiciary_art4section5tracker.opinions_r: opinions remain commentary on the law as written or edited · Art. IV §5
judiciary_art4section5tracker.override_v: Override — votes in favor of all serving
judiciary_art4section5tracker.path_a_leg: Path A — Legislature modifies or removes
judiciary_art4section5tracker.path_b_sup: Path B — Supermajority override in the veto window
judiciary_art4section5tracker.path_c_win: Path C — Window closes, judiciary edits the law
judiciary_art4section5tracker.supermajor: Supermajority of all serving members — not just those present — recorded within the veto window.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.the_law_st: The law stands as written; the finding, the override vote, and every member’s position are on the public record.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.the_legisl: The legislature has {timeframe_days} days to modify or remove the law (CLK-12, due {timeframe_due_on}) and {veto_window_days} days to override ({remedy}).
The legislature modifies or removes the law through the ordinary bill flow within the judicial timeframe.
judiciary_art4section5tracker.the_three_: The three Art. IV §5 resolution paths
judiciary_art4section5tracker.when_a_cou: When a court issues a finding under Art. IV §5, this tracker shows the finding, the recommended remedy, both clocks (CLK-11 / CLK-12), and the three resolution paths live.
judiciary_caselifecycle.back_and_advance: Back and Advance move through the sequence — simulation only.
judiciary_jurorscreening.a_panel_judge_f: A panel judge follows up on the answers you flagged. If a conflict is confirmed you are excused without penalty and the draw selects a replacement.
judiciary_jurorscreening.answer_honestly: Answer honestly — screening removes conflicts of interest, never opinions, demographics, or politics. Your answers go to the panel judges only.
judiciary_jurorscreening.you_remain_in_t: You remain in the panel pool. Empanelment is confirmed at voir dire.
